attributes.title: 41st SNRS Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The Southern Nursing Research Society holds its 41st Annual Conference from Wednesday, February 10, to Friday, February 12, 2027, at The Courtland Grand Hotel in Atlanta, Georgia. Daily sessions run from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. Eastern. The meeting brings together nurse scientists, faculty, doctoral students and clinical nurses who conduct or apply research, mostly from the southern states.

The program includes pre- and post-conference workshops, podium and poster sessions, symposia and a student poster session; all abstract calls closed by September 2026. Fees, the theme and contact hours were not shown on the SNRS event listing when we checked.
